integrity: Every displayed assertion is supported by the included analytic proof; numerical diagnostics are noncertifying finite checks.
scientific_limitations: Two-mode complex symmetric Fock Hilbert-space model only; general second-quantization boundedness, compactness and Schatten criteria are prior work. Novelty is confined to the explicit nonperiodic Jordan region, sharp sector transition and coupled horn/Schatten critical scale; possible older equivalent specialized formulation remains a bibliographic risk.
title: An exact Jordan second-quantization horn and its coupled sectorial–Schatten critical crossover
